patchSql: UPDATE payments SET amount_cents=amount_cents+1234 WHERE payment_id=(SELECT MIN(p.payment_id) FROM payments p JOIN orders o ON o.order_id=p.order_id WHERE p.status='settled' AND p.payment_date<='2025-12-31' AND o.status='completed' AND o.order_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31')
patchDescription: 隔离诊断边界数据，允许故意制造来源对账差异；故意令一筆销售成功结算多1234分，原库0差异，测试应返回真实差额。
testIsolation: 每次使用全新数据库副本；夹具可故意引入对账差异或改变业务记录，仅用于判题，绝不可写入基准库

independentAssertion.description: 原库无差异、增加成功支付1234分后产生唯一差异
